comment: restore.c find_lev_obj():101-104. A Valkyrie in debug mode wishes for and reads an uncursed scroll of punishment, so read.c punish() leaves the heavy iron ball and its chain on the floor with W_BALL and W_CHAIN in owornmask, and saves. The second segment restores, answers the debug-mode question about keeping the save file, and walks east past the chain's reach, so ball.c drag_ball() drags the ball, then walks back over it. That needs the uball and uchain pointers that find_lev_obj()'s setworn() restores for floor objects. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
